about.title: Cloverdale Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Cloverdale is a small town at the northern edge of Sonoma County, home to about 8,811 people, and a loss here is felt on nearly every block. In 2025, the city's public collision record showed 13 injury crashes and 18 people hurt, with no traffic deaths recorded that year. That is welcome news, but wrongful death claims in Cloverdale do not arise from roads alone. A fall on poorly kept property, a fatal error in medical care, a workplace accident in a vineyard or on a job site, or a collision along US-101 or Cloverdale Boulevard can each take a life that should not have been lost. California law lets the closest survivors bring a civil claim for what that loss has cost them. It is separate from any criminal case, and it moves on its own timeline. Our team handles these cases on contingency, so your family can focus on grieving while we focus on the details.

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California gives standing first to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. Our team can sort out where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: The two-year clock is watched closely
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Getting in touch early protects that deadline.

items.title: Recovery that reflects the whole loss
items.desc: Recoverable damages include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Our fee is contingent, so there is no charge unless money is recovered.

items.question: There were no traffic deaths in Cloverdale in 2025. Can I still have a wrongful death case?
items.answer: Yes. Traffic collisions are only one of many causes behind wrongful death claims. If a loved one died because of negligent medical care, an unsafe property, a workplace hazard, a defective product, or a crash on US-101 in a different year, the claim rests on whether someone's carelessness caused the death, not on where it appears in a city's collision count.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as the criminal case?
items.answer: No. A criminal case is brought by the district attorney and is about punishment. A wrongful death claim is a civil action brought by the family to recover for their losses. The two can proceed at the same time, and a civil claim can succeed even when no criminal charges are filed.

items.question: What does it cost to contact us about a wrongful death case?
items.answer: Nothing. We offer a free consultation, and we handle wrongful death cases on contingency. That means no fee unless there is a recovery, and you decide whether to move forward after the first conversation.
